description: This file defines an interface for setting a refresh token within the OAuth2 client library, specifically in the 'Token' namespace. It declares a single method 'setRefreshToken' which is intended to be implemented by classes that manage refresh tokens.

classes.name: SettableRefreshTokenInterface
classes.description: An interface that requires implementing classes to provide a method for setting a refresh token.

methods.name: setRefreshToken
methods.description: Sets or replaces the refresh token with the provided refresh token.
